svg.title: The research loop behind Flint
svg.desc: Diagram of the automated research loop Recursive says built much of Flint: propose an idea, implement it, run an experiment, validate against reward hacking, and choose the next experiment, with a human-oversight checkpoint marked on the loop, and two notes separating what is public and inspectable from what is vendor-reported.

text.tspan: What an automated research system does — and what is still vendor-reported.
Recursive states humans oversee and can stop the loop
Automated research under human oversight is demonstrated.
